info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Localization & Reference Data
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Localization & Reference Data.** Locale management, content translations, machine translation, and the language / country / currency reference lists.

get.summary: List all locales for the organization (including disabled, for admin)

200.description: All locales of the organization, default locale first, then by sort order and code.

201.description: The created locale (the BCP-47 code is normalized, e.g. `en-us` → `en-US`).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List enabled locales only (for content editing)

200.description: Enabled locales only, default locale first (cached per organization for 5 minutes).
The default locale; falls back to the first enabled locale, and lazily seeds an `en` default when the organization has no locales yet.

get.summary: Get a single locale by ID

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete a locale (must not be default, must have no content)

200.description: Deletion acknowledgement. The locale is also removed from any other locale's fallback chain.

get.summary: Get the fallback chain for a locale

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

post.summary: Set a locale as the default

201.description: The locale, now flagged as default (the previous default is unset in the same transaction).

get.summary: Get translation status for a content item across all locales

200.description: Per-locale task and field-completeness status for the content item, across all enabled locales.

get.summary: List all translation tasks (filterable by status and assignee)

200.description: Translation tasks of the organization with content summary and assignee, ordered by priority (desc), due date, then creation date.
The translation task including content summary and assignee.

put.summary: Update a translation task (status, assignee, priority, due date)

200.description: The updated task including the assignee (`completedAt` is set when the status becomes `completed`, cleared otherwise).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Create a translation task for a content item and target locale

201.description: The created task (status `pending`) including the assignee; a completed/cancelled task for the same locale is reused and reset.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Copy localized field values from one locale to another (fills missing only)

201.description: How many localized fields were copied into the target locale.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get info about the configured translation provider

200.description: The provider resolved from the organization settings.

get.summary: Get list of supported languages from the configured provider

200.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

post.summary: Detect the language of a text string

201.description: The detected language and confidence as reported by the provider (requires recorded consent — the text is sent externally).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: Provider settings with API keys masked to their last 4 characters, plus the consent status (IMP-I18N-03).
Settings saved. Masked API keys (`***…`) are treated as unchanged and the recorded consent is preserved.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Record data-processing consent for external machine translation (IMP-I18N-03)

201.description: Consent recorded (timestamp and accepting admin are stored in the org settings).
Outcome of the connection test — misconfiguration is reported as `success: false` with an `error`, not as an HTTP error.

post.summary: Machine-translate all localized fields in a content item

201.description: The translated content data plus a per-field outcome list. Only persisted when `save` is true; fields flagged `noMachineTranslate` are skipped.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

201.description: The translated text for the field (not saved to the content item).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.description: Proxies the authoritative currencies list from the Context Directory (CONTEXT_DIRECTORY_URL). Falls back to the bundled list if the Context Directory is unreachable.

200.description: The currency list with its origin (`source`). Always 200 — an unreachable Context Directory degrades to the bundled fallback.

get.description: Proxies the authoritative country list from the Context Directory (CONTEXT_DIRECTORY_URL). Falls back to a small EU+US bundled list if the Context Directory is unreachable.

200.description: The country list with its origin (`source`). Always 200 — an unreachable Context Directory degrades to the bundled fallback.

get.description: Proxies the authoritative language list from the Context Directory (CONTEXT_DIRECTORY_URL). Falls back to a bundled EU+major-world list if the Context Directory is unreachable.

200.description: The language list with its origin (`source`). Always 200 — an unreachable Context Directory degrades to the bundled fallback.

targetLocale.description: Locale the fields were translated into

data.description: The full content data with the target-locale values filled in. Keys are field IDs; localized values are `{ locale: value }` maps.

copiedFields.description: Number of fields copied (only fields missing in the target locale)

countries.description: The country list as served by the Context Directory (or the bundled fallback)

source.description: Where the list came from: the Context Directory, the in-process 1 hour cache, or the bundled fallback list

nativeName.description: Locale name in its own language

fallbackLocale.description: Fallback locale code when content is missing in this locale

assigneeId.description: User ID to assign translation to

decimals.description: Number of decimal places used for minor units (0 for e.g. JPY, 3 for KWD)

currencies.description: The currency list as served by the Context Directory (or the bundled fallback)

source.description: Where the list came from: the Context Directory, the in-process 1 hour cache, or the bundled fallback list

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

errors.description: Present on 422 content-validation failures: one entry per rule that failed. Absent otherwise.

path.description: JSON pointer to the offending field

keyword.description: The rule that fired, e.g. required, after_field, before_field, requiredIf, requiredUnless, asset_exists, reference_exists

targetLocale.description: Locale the field was translated into

translatedText.description: The translated plain text (not persisted — the caller decides whether to save it)

fieldId.description: Field ID of the content type

error.description: Provider error message (only when status is `error`)

languages.description: The language list as served by the Context Directory (or the bundled fallback)

source.description: Where the list came from: the Context Directory, the in-process 1 hour cache, or the bundled fallback list

deleted.description: Always true — the locale was deleted

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default locale of the organization

isEnabled.description: Whether the locale is enabled for content editing

fallbackLocale.description: Locale to fall back to when a field has no value in this locale

dateFormat.description: Date format pattern (null falls back to CLDR defaults)

timeFormat.description: Time format pattern (null falls back to CLDR defaults)

name.description: English display name of the locale

nativeName.description: Native display name of the locale

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default locale

task.description: Translation task for this locale (null when none exists)

completeness.description: Field-level translation completeness for this locale

fields.description: Specific field IDs to translate (omit to translate all)

save.description: Save translated data to the database

filled.description: Number of localized fields with a value in this locale

provider.description: Provider the test ran against (`none` when nothing is configured)

languages.description: Number of languages the provider reported (only on success)

providerId.description: Resolved provider for the organization (`noop` when nothing is configured)

provider.description: Configured provider. `pro-ai` routes through the governed pro-ai gateway; `none` means no machine translation (or the pro-ai default when the plugin is installed).

deeplApiKey.description: DeepL API key, masked to the last 4 characters (empty when unset)

googleApiKey.description: Google API key, masked to the last 4 characters (empty when unset)

azureApiKey.description: Azure API key, masked to the last 4 characters (empty when unset)

formality.description: Formality preference passed to providers that support it (DeepL)

consentAcceptedAt.description: When an admin recorded the data-processing consent (IMP-I18N-03)

consentAcceptedBy.description: UUID of the admin who recorded the consent

consentRequired.description: Whether an explicit CE-level consent is required before external dispatch (false for `none` and `pro-ai`)

consentGiven.description: Whether a consent has been recorded

sourceLocale.description: Source locale of the content item

locales.description: Per-locale translation status across all enabled locales

contentTypeId.description: Content type ID the item belongs to

locale.description: Source locale of the content item

contentId.description: Content UUID the task belongs to

completedAt.description: When the task was marked completed

content.description: Summary of the content item (present on task list/detail endpoints)

nativeName.description: Locale name in its own language

fallbackLocale.description: Fallback locale code when content is missing in this locale

provider.description: 'pro-ai' routes through the governed pro-ai gateway (canonical when the plugin is installed; also the default for 'none' in that case). The remaining ids are the CE-native EU providers used when Pro is absent.
